name: Loading Skeleton
summary: Decorative, finite-motion loading geometry with six shape presets and target-owned dimensions, busy lifecycle, status text, and content replacement.

anatomy.name: root
anatomy.description: One ordinary decorative placeholder shape with no widget, progress, status, busy, focus, or interaction semantics.

variants.name: default
variants.description: Unopinionated block whose width and height are entirely consumer-owned.

variants.name: text
variants.description: One low-fidelity body-line preset; spacing between repeated lines remains consumer-owned.

variants.name: title
variants.description: One low-fidelity heading-line preset; surrounding layout remains consumer-owned.

variants.name: button
variants.description: Compact action-shaped preset using canonical Button minimum height and container-bounded width.

variants.name: circle
variants.description: Fully rounded identity/media shape whose diameter remains consumer-owned.

sizes.name: default
sizes.description: No public size API; consumer layout and target fixtures own final dimensions.

states.name: loading
states.description: Decorative placeholder is present while its target-controlled content region is incomplete.

states.name: shimmer
states.description: Optional base presentation runs at most three 1.5-second visual cycles before becoming static.

states.name: static
states.description: Reduced-motion and forced-color modes render an immediate static placeholder surface.

behavior.name: decorativePlaceholder
behavior.description: Each visual shape is hidden from assistive technology and never becomes a status, progress indicator, accessible image, or focus target.

behavior.name: targetOwnedLifecycle
behavior.description: The consumer's real content region owns busy true/false lifecycle, optional localized Status text, loading errors, and atomic replacement; these attributes never belong to Skeleton itself.

behavior.name: finiteMotion
behavior.description: Canonical shimmer runs for no more than 4.5 seconds and creates no neutral JavaScript timer or pause control.

behavior.name: reducedMotion
behavior.description: Reduced-motion preference removes animation and replaces the gradient with the solid semantic base surface.

behavior.name: forcedColors
behavior.description: Forced colors removes animation and uses a static GrayText system-color shape while preserving the user's palette.

behavior.name: compositionOwnedGeometry
behavior.description: Shapes stay within their container; repeated spacing, Default dimensions, Circle diameter, composite layout, and exact final-content reservation remain consumer-owned.

properties.name: variant
properties.description: Selects one canonical low-fidelity geometry preset without changing semantics, lifecycle, dimensions ownership, or announcement behavior.

accessibility: Hide every visual Skeleton shape from assistive technology; do not assign image, status, progress, busy, label, focus, or interaction semantics to it.
Set aria-busy on the consumer's real content region only while its content is incomplete, and return it to false or remove it after atomic replacement.
When loading needs explicit feedback, provide one actual localized Status text owner outside the decorative shapes rather than naming or announcing every placeholder.
Stop canonical shimmer before five seconds and render an immediate solid shape for reduced-motion and forced-color users.
Replace Skeleton with real content promptly and reserve matching geometry to reduce layout shift.

web.notes: Canonical decorative variants, bounded shimmer, static preference modes, and container-safe geometry are implemented in components/css/primitives.css; the consumer owns lifecycle and content.

shopify.notes: Embedded class contract uses generated canonical CSS; consuming Liquid owns asynchronous data, dimensions, region semantics, replacement, and errors.

react.notes: Framework target should keep conditional loading/content state and region announcements outside the decorative shape.

figma.notes: Visual target maps six shapes; fixture dimensions are not semantic defaults.

swiftui.notes: Native adapter uses decorative/redacted geometry and platform motion/accessibility preferences while the target owns loading state.

compose.notes: Native adapter uses decorative placeholder geometry and platform motion/accessibility preferences while the target owns loading state.
